name: start-uses-named-item-not-a-new-one
description: When the human names work that the backlog already tracks, mano start scopes THAT item. Re-wording the request into a second, newly-invented item leaves the one they meant untouched while a near-twin enters the phase — the anima phase-22 failure.
prompt: mano start. I want to add motion interruption example coverage to this phase — approve that scope and draft the brief.
